Package com.codedstream.otterstream.experiments.stats

Record Class StatisticalTest.ComparisonResult

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.codedstream.otterstream.experiments.stats.StatisticalTest.ComparisonResult
Record Components:
controlMean - mean of the control group's observations
variantMean - mean of the variant group's observations
controlSampleSize - number of control observations
variantSampleSize - number of variant observations
statistic - the test statistic (t or z, depending on which test produced this)
pValue - two-tailed p-value (approximate for StatisticalTest.welchTTest(java.util.List<java.lang.Double>, java.util.List<java.lang.Double>), see class Javadoc)
significantAt95 - convenience: pValue < 0.05
Enclosing class:
StatisticalTest
public static record StatisticalTest.ComparisonResult(double controlMean, double variantMean, int controlSampleSize, int variantSampleSize, double statistic, double pValue, boolean significantAt95) extends Record
Result of a two-sample comparison.
